title: Choose the Match visual world
question: Re-roll with Greek gods in the mix. The roll assigned Divine Chariot Tote. Keep it, take an alternate, re-roll, or take the category standard.

options.label: Divine Chariot Tote
options.lineage: Hippodrome tote boards and god-patron chariot cards
options.thesis: Draft picks god-backed entries; the Match is the race under the tote glass inside the run booth.
options.viewport: Desktop: run shell as stadium booth rails; center tote glass with dual-seat entry columns; Weapon/Boon offers as god-stamped tickets; fight as live odds/Life reels with purple active leg.
options.risk: Can read as sportsbook chrome if god seals and divine entry art stay weak.

options.label: Orienteering Course
options.lineage: ISO orienteering maps with purple course over terrain
options.thesis: The run is terrain; Match is the purple course leg you punch through god-marked controls.
options.viewport: Map fills the run shell; Match is a clipped purple leg window; Draft is control descriptions; Life punches check off.
options.risk: God identity is only in control names unless seals and icons carry weight.
options.case: Wins run-shell navigation clarity; thin on divine spectacle.

options.label: Broadcast Teletext
options.lineage: 40×24 teletext magazines with live scores and REVEAL
options.thesis: Match is a keyed results page; Draft is a magazine; fog lifts on REVEAL when the fight starts.
options.viewport: Run shell as page index; Match page with twin cyan Life figures; offer rows as numbered blocks; opponent fog as REVEAL-hidden spans.
options.risk: Myth flavor is almost none unless god pages earn mosaic art.
options.case: Wins live-score clarity and Draft fog; fuses poorly with Greek-god presence.

options.label: CRT Arcade Glow
options.lineage: Pixel arcade cabinets with phosphor bloom and scanlines
options.thesis: Gods are sprite bosses; Draft is the select screen; the fight is the glowing playfield inside the run cabinet.
options.viewport: Integer-scaled Match stage in shell; god select as sprite roster; Loadout as HUD icons; fires as palette-flash hits.
options.risk: Reads as generic arcade unless god roster art is unmistakable.
options.case: Wins kinetic spectacle; god flavor is painted on, not native to CRT grammar.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark auto-battler HUD with shop-row Draft and twin HP bars, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Familiar TFT/Auto Chess chrome with a light Greek skin on card names only.
canonCard.risk: Expected; gods stay labels, not the visual system.
